test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which year was the 5G telecommunications technology launched in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 5G telecommunications technology was launched in India in** 2022**.
 
• The government of India successfully concluded the 5G spectrum auction on August 1, 2022, and the fifth-generation telecom services were rolled out in India on October 1, 2022 to the first **13 cities**, which include** Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Chandigarh, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Lucknow, Pune, Gandhinagar, Ahmedabad, Jamshedpur, and Visakhapatnam**.
 
• The 5G spectrum auction was conducted in **two phases**.
 
• In the first phase, **72.205 MHz** of spectrum in the **3.3-3.67 GHz** band was auctioned, and in the second phase, **28.250 MHz **of spectrum in the** 700 MHz** band was auctioned.
 
• The total auction revenue was around Rs. **4.3 lakh crore**.
